object.title: Chen–Lev conjecture on periodic intersections of representation-equivalent sets
object.statement:
Let $C$ and $D$ be different sets of nonnegative integers, and let $R_C(n)$ count representations of $n$ as a sum of two distinct elements of $C$, with the analogous definition for $D$. Assume

$$
C\cup D=\mathbb N,
$$

$$
C\cap D=r+m\mathbb N,
$$

where $r\ge0$ and $m\ge2$ are integers.

**Chen–Lev conjecture.** If $R_C(n)=R_D(n)$ for every positive integer $n$, then there exists an integer $l\ge1$ such that

$$
r=2^{2l}-1,\qquad m=2^{2l+1}-1.
$$

This question seeks a classification of covering pairs with periodic intersection and identical two-element representation functions. The source presents the assertion as a question posed by Chen and Lev; no resolution is supplied.
object.source_name: Sándor Z. Kiss and Csaba Sándor, “On the structure of sets which have coinciding representation functions”, arXiv:1702.04499 (2020).
object.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.04499

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2017).

object.title: Monoidality conjecture for the shape functor of constructible polygraphs
object.literal_statement: Let $\mathbf{CPol}$ be the category of constructible polygraphs, with monoidal structures given by the lax Gray product $\scaleobj{0.75}{\boxtimes}$ and the join $\star$, and let $\omega\mathbf{Cat}$ be the category of $\omega$-categories with the corresponding monoidal structures. The shape functor is denoted by $-_{\omega}:\mathbf{CPol}\to\omega\mathbf{Cat}$. **Monoidality conjecture.** The functor $-_{\omega}$ is monoidal both from $(\mathbf{CPol},\,\scaleobj{0.75}{\boxtimes},1)$ to $(\omega\mathbf{Cat},\,\scaleobj{0.75}{\boxtimes},1)$ and from $(\mathbf{CPol},\,\star,\emptyset)$ to $(\omega\mathbf{Cat},\,\star,\emptyset)$. This would show that the combinatorial shape construction preserves both fundamental monoidal structures relevant to higher categories; the source presents it as an expected result, with no proof or resolution supplied.
object.finding_and_precise_gap: Need natural strong comparison isomorphisms for both Gray and join plus units/coherence on all constructible polygraphs. Restricted freely-generating results do not supply the whole claim.
